access.title: Access
access.localAlways: Always browsable in this workspace (cannot be turned off)
access.hintNeedConnectionReason: Remote access tiers require a storage connection. Nothing can be published yet.
access.hintNeedConnectionAlt: You can keep files local-only, or add GitHub/Gitee under Connections.
access.hintPublicReason: This connection does not declare a public URL capability.
access.hintPublicAlt: Keep files local-only, or switch to a connection that supports hotlink URLs (such as a public GitHub/Gitee repo).
access.hintShareReason: This connection cannot create a share link that is only reachable by URL.
access.hintShareAlt: Keep files local-only, use a public GitHub/Gitee raw URL, or share from the cloud vendor if available.
access.hintTimedReason: This connection cannot set link expiry or an access password.
access.hintTimedAlt: Use a public URL, or configure sharing expiry in the cloud vendor console.
access.hintReadyReason: This connection can generate a public hotlink. Confirm the repository is public before publishing.
access.hintReadyAlt: If you do not need the internet to open the file, keep “Not public on this cloud”.
access.cannotCopyUnpublished: Publishing is not selected. No public link was copied.
access.cannotCopyUnsupported: This connection does not support that access tier. No link was copied.
access.needSelectAsset: Select a file in the library before generating a link.
access.confirmSyncThenPublish: This file is not synced to the selected channel yet. Sync first, then publish?
access.revoked: Remote access revoked. The file remains in the local workspace
access.upcomingPublishHint: These services are not connected yet. Chips show planned capabilities, not features you can use today.
